symptom: After selection became a fill, Settings' GitHub method cards still turned border4 when chosen and composer pills drew a 2px ring while the caret selected them: the edge came from a condition (selected ? "border-border4 …"), which the variant-only check never read.
rule: ui/selection-edge also reads classes a selection condition adds (selected && …, tab === activeTab ? … : …); a border in the box's own fill colour, drop targets and focus stay exempt (findConditionalSelectionEdges in scripts/design-system/ui-policy.mjs).
